description: Get odds for one event from the named bookmakers, grouped by bookmaker then market, with bet links. Always pass markets (e.g. 'ML,Spread,Totals'): without it every market from every bookmaker comes back, which can be very large. Get the event id from get_events or search_events and market names from get_markets. For best/average prices across all books, get_odds_summary is more compact.

bookmakers.description: Comma-separated bookmaker names, max 30 (e.g. 'Bet365,SingBet'). Must be in the key's selection (get_selected_bookmakers).

markets.description: Comma-separated market names, case-insensitive, max 40 (e.g. 'ML,Spread,Totals'). Strongly recommended: without it every market is returned. Call get_markets for the exact names.

name: get_odds
title: Get odds for an event
